incarnation: The Crownless Sea — Capitaine Ysara Flint, current selected individual V2 original-project portrait2026

references.provenance: Exact selected V2 portrait recovered by root from local GitLFS object; identity and universe independently inspected by producer.

silhouette: Brown-skinned female-presenting sea captain with athletic human proportions, long black tightly braided hair swept back in loose braided strands; no hat or eyepatch.
anatomy: Two human arms and legs, normal hands and five fingers when readable; same apparent age and build as source.
face: Warm brown skin, focused dark/amber-readable eyes, dark brows and strong source profile; no invented tattoos or facial scars.
costume: Long deep-navy naval coat, gold embroidered edges and gold epaulettes, ivory open-collar shirt, brown cross-body leather bandolier with brass rectangular fittings; thick mustard/ochre rope sash at waist, grey-navy trousers with brown knee straps, tall dark brown buckle boots.
palette: Deep navy, ivory, ochre-yellow sash, brown leather, brass/gold; no old red sash.
distinguishingMarks: Black scalp braids trailing behind, gold hoop earring on visible source ear and small necklaces; source unseen opposite ear details unspecified.
equipment: ONE curved silver cutlass with ornate gold hilt in anatomical RIGHT hand; ONE dark-and-brass long-barrel flintlock pistol in anatomical LEFT hand. No modern revolver or modern firearm, no duplicate arms or weapons.
forbiddenMixes: Old lighter-skinned unarmed wavy-ponytail/red-sash sprite is a historical variant, never an identity source.
No generic European pirate, tricorn hat, eye patch, red waist scarf, straight sword, mirrored cutlass/pistol or borrowed franchise design.

scopeLimitations: Original individual portrait currently selected by HEROES_DB and production.audiovisual; this is internal original-project authority, not an external franchise source.

Single three-quarter portrait does not establish reverse costume construction, hidden attachments, tiny weapon inscriptions, opposite-ear ornamentation or chronological age. No perfect1:1 certification.
Original age-of-sail free-port setting: elected crews resist ownership of sea routes. Newly composed locations are compatible settings, not official screenshots.
Nexus action is an identified gameplay adaptation; beach/service/comedy are Fan Art; alignment/gender/corruption/future variants are What If.
The old atlas stays unchanged and accessible as a historical variant after root integration.

incarnationDecision.reason: Source has brown skin, braided hair, ochre rope sash, RIGHT cutlass and LEFT flintlock; old sprite is lighter-skinned, wavy-haired, red-sashed and unarmed.
